# Beta Tester Checklist

Please verify the following areas of the application:

### 1. Authentication
- [ ] Sign in with Password.
- [ ] Sign in with Quick Connect.
- [ ] Session persists after app restart.
- [ ] Sign out clears all local state.

### 2. Media Navigation
- [ ] Home Hero loads correctly.
- [ ] "Continue Watching" shelf appears with progress.
- [ ] Music playback starts from Albums/Artists.
- [ ] Reading library discovery (Books, Comics, Manga).

### 3. Playback
- [ ] Video starts quickly with synchronized audio.
- [ ] Subtitles can be toggled in Settings.
- [ ] Background music continues when leaving the app.
- [ ] Reader transitions smoothly between pages.

### 4. System
- [ ] Focus border (Cyan) is clearly visible.
- [ ] Back button returns to Home or expected previous screen.
- [ ] Diagnostic report correctly copies to clipboard.
